_comment: Defaults for `node pipeline/cli.js tts` (pipeline/tts.js, config/audio.md). Precedence per key: CLI flag > script.md frontmatter (tts_model / tts_voice / tts_speed) > the model/voice this video last used (voiceover/tts/meta.json; not speed) > env (TTS_MODEL / TTS_VOICE / TTS_SPEED) > this file. There is deliberately NO default voice: the creator names one per video, and the agent asks which before generating.
